name: Frodo's Cloak
game_text:
Bearer must be Frodo.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: At sites 1<block>Tower</block> to 4<block>Tower</block>, add a burden and discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving Frodo. At any other site, discard this possession to remove a burden and heal Frodo.
flavor_text: Neither weather nor searching eyes found Frodo.
